topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: Adaptive beamforming and rate-splitting multiple access mitigate inter-beam interference, optimizing beam performance. Non-uniform array geometries reduce mutual coupling effects, improving signal-to-noise ratio. Beam squint effects are managed through optimized beamforming strategies, balancing array factor gains and interference costs.
reference_context: Max beam gain is 51.8 dBi, and noise power density is -204 dBW/MHz, impacting SatCom system performance.
